name: FutureFuel Corp.

shortInterest.source: equibles.com (945K shares short, 2.2% of float, 3.1 days to cover)

cash.note: Company stated a plan to rebuild cash to $50M over the next year post-Q3 2026 (Seeking Alpha), implying cash is currently below that target; exact Q3 2026 cash balance not confirmed from a primary source.

pe.note: negative trailing earnings (FY2025 net loss; Q3 2026 net loss)

growth.note: Revenue $104.7M vs $22.7M in Q3 2025; some sources describe this as a '361%' increase (biofuel revenue specifically was cited elsewhere as up ~1,137% YoY).

nextEarnings.note: Not established; FY2025 annual results were released mid-March 2026, suggesting FY2026 annual results likely land similarly in March 2027, but this is inferred, not confirmed.

price.note: First confirmed post-earnings closing price found (prior pass had none). A separate source (Kalkine) reports the same day's close as $2.84 (-43.98%) off a 'calculated' prior close -- both figures recorded; not reconciled. Prior close used by financialcontent was $5.07 (2026-11-09).

catalysts.headline: FutureFuel fell ~30% premarket after its Q3 2026 results; no further detail (reported figures, consensus comparison) located beyond the aggregator mover headline this session.

FutureFuel Q3 2026 results: revenue $104.7M (up from $22.7M in Q3 2025); net loss $8.4M (-$0.19/diluted share) vs $9.2M loss a year earlier; Biofuel segment posted a $9.8M gross loss on elevated feedstock costs and $8.7M in derivative losses despite record production/sales volumes and higher utilization; Chemicals segment revenue grew from capacity expansions despite maintenance-driven volume declines; management said orders booked through early November covered >90% of Q4 biodiesel production capacity and guided to ~$7M of Q4 adjusted EBITDA; plan outlined to rebuild cash to $50M over the next year
catalysts.impact: Stock fell sharply after the print; magnitude reported inconsistently across sources from -29% to -45% (see conflicts)

catalysts.headline: FutureFuel declared Q3 2026 cash dividend of $0.01/share (payable Sept. 18, 2026 to holders of record Sept. 4, 2026), maintaining the reduced rate
Board of Directors cut the quarterly dividend from $0.06/share to $0.01/share effective for Q2 2026, to preserve cash for projects and opportunistic buybacks
catalysts.source: search aggregation citing company disclosure (exact primary URL not retrieved)

conflicts: Post-earnings stock-price decline reported inconsistently: Arkansas Business says shares 'fell as much as 29%' after closing at $5.07 (closest match to the task's stated ~30% figure); Investing.com reports a ~45.17% drop to $2.78 from $5.07; Alphastreet reports the stock at $2.99, down 41.0%; a Motley Fool transcript page shows -38.46%. These may reflect different measurement windows (after-hours vs. next-day regular session vs. cumulative multi-day) that were not reconciled from available sources.

Revenue growth YoY for Q3 2026 described as both '361%' (stocktitan headline) and the biofuel segment specifically as '+1,137%' (biobased-diesel.com) -- likely referring to different scopes (total company vs. biofuel segment) but not fully reconciled.

The task's stated catalyst (-30% premarket move, 2026-11-11) most closely matches the Arkansas Business figure (~29%, after-hours) dated to the Nov 9 release, not a distinct Nov 11 move; no separate Nov 11-dated price action was found.
notes: No new catalyst beyond the Q3 2026 earnings print already on file. Cash balance, debt and next-earnings date remain unestablished.
